name: Supplier Inquiry Automation - Workflow 1

options.systemMessage: You are a professional procurement manager writing supplier inquiry emails. Generate clear, concise, and professional emails.
You are a professional procurement manager writing follow-up emails. Be polite, brief, and professional.

parameters.subject: =Re: Inquiry: {{ $("Receive Inquiry Request").item.json.body.productName }} - ChainMind Supply Intelligence

value.subject: =Re: Inquiry: {{ $("Receive Inquiry Request").item.json.body.productName }} - ChainMind Supply Intelligence

parameters.text:
=Extract the following information from this supplier email:

Email: {{ $("Check Gmail Every 5 Minutes").item.json.text }}

Extract and return ONLY a JSON object with these fields:
- pricePerUnit: number (extract the unit price)
- deliveryDate: string (ISO date format if mentioned)
- moq: number (minimum order quantity)
- paymentTerms: string (e.g., "Net 30", "50% upfront")
- contactDetails: string (phone or additional contact info)

If any field is not mentioned, use null. Return ONLY valid JSON, no other text.

options.systemMessage: You are a data extraction assistant. Extract structured information from emails and return only valid JSON.

parameters.query:
SELECT ei.*, s.company_name, s.contact_email, s.contact_name
FROM email_interactions ei
JOIN suppliers s ON ei.supplier_id = s.id
WHERE ei.status = 'sent'
AND ei.sent_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM email_interactions ei2
  WHERE ei2.thread_id = ei.thread_id
  AND ei2.status IN ('reply_received', 'follow_up_sent')
)
